CFML Language Reference: Functions

DateAdd

Returns a new date/time value that is a given number of units later (or earlier, for a negative number) than the date you pass in.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DateAdd(datepart, number, date)

Parameters

datepart
The unit to add, one of: yyyy year, q quarter, m month, y day of year, d day, w weekday, ww week, h hour, n minute, s second. Case does not matter.
number
How many units to add. Use a negative number to go back in time. Fractions are dropped (1.7 adds 1).
date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A date/time value.

Usage

y, d and w all add whole days in KoldFusion, ww adds seven days at a time. Note that minutes are n; m is months, a classic source of appointments booked thirty days too late.

Adding months, quarters or years keeps the day of the month where possible. If the target month is shorter, the result is pinned to its last day: one month after January 31, 2000 is February 29, 2000 (a leap year, despite the rumors), and one year after February 29, 2000 is February 28, 2001.

Any other datepart throws an "Invalid date part" error.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Base = CreateDate(2000, 1, 31)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Starting from #DateFormat(Base, "mmmm d, yyyy")#:</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Expression</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Part" LIST="yyyy,q,m,ww,d">
<TR><TD>DateAdd("#Part#", 1, Base)</TD>
    <TD>#DateFormat(DateAdd(Part, 1, Base), "mmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
<TR><TD>DateAdd("d", -31, Base)</TD><TD>#DateFormat(DateAdd("d", -31, Base), "mmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>DateAdd("h", 36, Base)</TD><TD>#DateAdd("h", 36, Base)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>DateAdd("n", 90, Base)</TD><TD>#DateAdd("n", 90, Base)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
